apps.localizedDescription:
Stossycord Rewrite:

Stossycord is a Discord Client Native to iOS Devices. It is made in 100% Swift and SwiftUI for Privacy, Responsiveness and Security.

Requirements:

• iPhone or iPad with iOS 15+.

Features:

• Sending messages.
• Receiving messages (text).
• Replying to messages.
• Uploading attachments (images, video, files).
• Receiving attachments (images, video, audio, files).
• Receiving Embeds (any).
• Direct Messages (send & receive).

• User Profiles.
• Basic channel list and navigation.
• Forums & Threads.
• Basic account/session management (login/logout).
• Showing Typing Indicators.
• Notifications & Mentions (Notifcations via Local Notifications with Location to keep app in background, no location data is sent anywhere and is just discarded).
• Custom emojis + FakeNitro Emojis.
• Favourited GIFs.
• Reactions (view/add/remove).

versions.localizedDescription:
• Brand New Login UI with Captcha and 2fa.
• Overhauled Channel UI with Custom Emojis, Reactions, Favourited GIFs, Loading More Messages, etc.
• Message Date, Divider between days.
• FakeNitro Emojis.

• Updated Apple Music RPC.
• Mentions (Pings) & Notifications (with Push Notification workaround using Location to keep app alive in background).
• Mentions View (Button to view where you've been pinged).
• Server List.
• iOS 15 Support.
• Updated WebSocket Handling.
• Loading Screen when Connecting to WebSocket.
